response.original_title: مرثیه‌ای برای فراموش‌شدگان، در باب جنگی بی‌پایان
response.overview: Between December 2025 and January 2026, the Iranian government massacred thousands of protestors; in February 2026, US forces began a bombing campaign against the country. As the Iranian administration seeks to control images of these events, filmmaker Bani Khoshnoudi interrogates the violence.
response.title: Elegy For The Forgotten, On An Endless War
